newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Tianjin to start polyester project in '97.
newsitem.headline: China's Tianjin to start polyester project in '97.

text.p: China's Tianjin Petrochemical Corp will early next year start construction of the second phase of a petrochemical project intended to produce 200,000 tonnes of polyester a year, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
Investment in the second phase of the project in the northern Chinese port city of Tianjin would reach 10 billion yuan ($120 million), the official agency said.
It did not say when the second phase would be completed.
The project, controlled by Tianjin Petrochemical Corp, would provide raw materials for the chemical fibre industry, it said.
Construction of the project's oil-refining first phase began in Tianjin in 1993 and would be completed in 1998, it said without elaborating.
The whole project was expected to achieve sales income of five billion yuan a year when completed, it said.
